title: products.jsonc
description: Products on the home page, in the order listed. Each id becomes the page at /<id>/.

name.description: The product's name, shown on the home page and its own page.

author.description: Who made it. At least one person id from people.jsonc.

tagline.description: One line under the name on the product page.

description.description: One plain sentence used for the meta description and the social card.

kind.description: software (the default) is an icon on the home page. A website is a browser bar there, and its page is a browser window on a wallpaper.

url.description: The live address, shown in a website's browser bar. Required when kind is website.

icon.description: Path to the icon image relative to this file, for example ../assets/products/<id>/icon.svg. Without one, the page shows a letter.

wallpaper.description: Websites only: the desktop image behind the browser window, for example ../assets/products/<id>/wallpaper.jpg. Without one, the shared default is used.

accent.description: A CSS color used for the product page's accents, for example #57e7cd.

platforms.description: Where it runs, for example macOS or iOS.

status.description: Shown as a badge on the product page.

support.description: People who helped the author. Person ids from people.jsonc. May be empty.

label.description: The button text, for example Download.

links.description: Buttons on the product page: App Store, download, GitHub and so on.

slug.description: The URL slug: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Never index or 404.
